item.title: Kichiku Shitsuji
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Dark Shelf
  • 発売日: 2011-05-27
  • スコア: 6.05/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 鬼畜執事
  • 英語名: Kichiku Shitsuji

あらすじ

Somewhere in Tokyo—Fujimura.

The wail of police sirens echoes through the night-lit streets of the business district.

The man being arrested is Daichi Okuyama, the young president of a rising investment bank.

The charge? The murder of his wife and daughter.

In his solitary cell, he begins to piece things together.

“What the hell is this? I killed my wife and daughter?

あらすじ

A spirit who takes the form of an attractive male is attacking many female students at a school. Two students discover that the only way to free him from his wander arround Earth is to have him fullfill his desire and so they decide to take hands on and make him rest in peace at last.
